    # Navigate to the Manage Customers page by clicking the link with the specific URL
    manage_customers_link = page.get_by_role("link", name="Manage Customers")
    await manage_customers_link.wait_for(state="visible")
    await manage_customers_link.click()
    # Wait for navigation to complete with a longer timeout
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle", timeout=10000)
